_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-21: Broken Trust. Year 2 Summer — traitor investigation, major Forgive/Banish branch.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: We have a problem. The Marauders knew exactly where our patrol gaps were during the last raid. That's not luck — that's intelligence.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I concur. The attack vector was too precise. Someone in Coppervale is feeding them information.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: A traitor? Among our own people? I refuse to believe—

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Belief doesn't change facts, Mayor. Jack, I need you to investigate. Quietly. If word gets out, the spy will go to ground.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: A spy? That's terrifying. I mean, I'm in the workshop all day — I wouldn't notice if someone was being shady.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: Actually... wait. Wes has been making extra courier runs lately. He said they were supply pickups, but the manifests didn't match when I checked the parts inventory.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Someone's selling us out? Can't say I'm surprised. Fear makes people do stupid things.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Look, I pour drinks. People talk. And Wes... he's been drinking alone lately. Nervous. Jumpy. He flinches every time someone mentions the Marauders.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Could be guilt. Could be fear. Either way, something's eating at him.

lines.speaker: npc_nora
lines.text: Wes? He's... he's a good man, Jack. But he's been different since spring. Distant. He won't tell me what's wrong.

lines.speaker: npc_nora
lines.text: I found a letter he'd hidden. It was in Marauder code — I recognized the cipher marks from Harrow's intelligence briefings. I... I didn't know what to do.

lines.speaker: npc_nora
lines.text: Please, Jack. Whatever happened, I know Wes. He wouldn't do this willingly. Something must have forced his hand.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I've decoded the intercepted communications. The cipher is Iron Marauder standard issue. The content confirms patrol schedules, supply routes, and defense positions were transmitted.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: But Jack — there's something else. The final message reads: 'Compliance confirmed. Family status: secured.' I believe Wes was coerced. They have leverage over him.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: His family. He mentioned a sister and nephew in a settlement east of here. If the Marauders are holding them...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Wes. We need to talk.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: ...You know, don't you.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: They have my sister, Jack. Ellie and her boy, Tomm. A lieutenant came to me in spring. Said if I didn't cooperate, they'd... he showed me proof. A photograph. A knife.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: I know what I did is unforgivable. I put everyone here at risk. But I couldn't let them die. I couldn't.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: People DID die, Wes. In the raid you enabled. Three guard bots destroyed. Nora nearly caught a crossbow bolt.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: I know. God, I know. I've been dying inside every day since. Just... do what you have to do.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Jack... this is your call. You're the one who uncovered it. You're the one who has to decide what happens next.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: He betrayed us. Banishment is the minimum. In wartime, it would be worse.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: A coerced asset is still an asset — but turned the other way. Think strategically, not emotionally.

choices.text: Wes, you were put in an impossible situation. We forgive you — and we're going to get your family back.
What you did endangered every person in this town. You need to leave Coppervale. Today.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You heard me. The Marshal uses fear to control people. We don't. That's the whole point of what we're building here.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: A wise choice. Wes, from now on you report directly to me. Every message the Marauders send you, I see first. We feed them exactly what we want them to know.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: I... yes. Yes, Commander. I'll do whatever it takes. I swear it.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Hmph. I hope you're right about this, Jack. If he betrays us again...

lines.speaker: npc_nora
lines.text: Thank you, Jack. Thank you.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack, I have logged the Marauder communication protocols from Wes's intercepted messages. We can now craft disinformation. This is a significant intelligence advantage.

lines.speaker: npc_wes
lines.text: I understand. I deserve worse.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Wes... take supplies. Enough for a week's travel. I won't send a man out to die, even one who betrayed us.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Justice was served. The town is safer. We'll need a new courier — I'll handle logistics.

lines.speaker: npc_nora
lines.text: Jack... I understand why. But please — if you ever hear anything about his sister and her boy... please tell me.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The town's morale has stabilized. The people see that betrayal has consequences. It is a harsh lesson, but a clear one.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: It's done. Whatever path we chose, we move forward together. That's what matters now.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: The Marshal will realize his spy has gone silent eventually. We need to be ready for his response. It won't be subtle.
